content.en: An ongoing UI/UX redesign for Stoles University, a custom graduation-stole brand. I am reworking the homepage to make product discovery, quality differences and custom ordering easier to understand.
content.zh: 为定制毕业绶带品牌 Stoles University 进行中的 UI/UX 网页重设计。我正在重新组织首页，让产品浏览、工艺差异与定制下单流程更清晰。

title.en: A clearer path from inspiration to ordering
title.zh: 从灵感浏览到定制下单

text.en: The redesigned homepage connects a product gallery, craft comparisons and a three-step ordering guide. Separate entry points help visitors choose between designing online and getting support from the team.
text.zh: 改版将产品画廊、工艺对比和三步定制流程串联起来，并为自主设计与团队协助提供清晰的入口。

text.en: I am developing the page structure and visual interface in Figma and Shopify, bringing together content hierarchy, responsive layouts and interactive product comparisons. The work is currently in development.
text.zh: 我使用 Figma 与 Shopify 推进页面结构和视觉界面设计，整理内容层级、适配不同屏幕，并搭建可交互的产品对比展示。目前项目仍在进行中。

title.en: Jingxi Encounters: Cultural Tourism Business Development
title.zh: 京喜乡逢：文旅商业开发与文创产品策划

content.en: A collection of heritage-inspired products for Shuiyuzui Village, Beijing. The project connects an established hiking destination with local stories, visitor experiences, and opportunities for village income.
content.zh: 以北京水峪嘴村和京西古道为主题的系列文创项目，将已有徒步客流与地方故事、游客体验和村民增收机会连接起来。

caption.en: Audience research: matching visitor groups with activities and purchase occasions. Original project presentation, p. 17.
caption.zh: 客群研究：将游客类型与活动、购买场景对应。原项目演示材料第17页。

caption.en: Jing Xiao Xi: a lion character with peach blossoms, a pack-animal bell, and hoof-shaped boots. Product catalogue, p. 24 (left).
caption.zh: 京小喜：结合山桃花、驮运铃铛和蹄形靴的狮子形象。产品画册第24页左侧。

caption.en: The mascot across charms, stickers, red envelopes, and digital expressions. Product catalogue, p. 24 (right).
caption.zh: 吉祥物在挂件、贴纸、红包和表情包上的延展。产品画册第24页右侧。

caption.en: Jingxi Heritage: illustrations of landmarks along the ancient road. Product catalogue, p. 27 (left).
caption.zh: 京西古韵：古道沿线地标插画。产品画册第27页左侧。

caption.en: Cut-out postcards connect the illustrated landmarks with the places visitors encounter. Product catalogue, p. 27 (right).
caption.zh: 镂空明信片连接插画地标与游客沿途看到的实景。产品画册第27页右侧。

caption.en: Collectible stamp concepts featuring local buildings, village scenes, and travel motifs. Product catalogue, p. 29 (right).
caption.zh: 以地方建筑、村景和行旅意象为主题的邮票设计。产品画册第29页右侧。

caption.en: Ancient Road Nostalgia: four seasonal magnets combine into one circular set. Product catalogue, p. 30.
caption.zh: 古道乡愁：四季扇形冰箱贴可组合为完整圆形。产品画册第30页。

caption.en: The proposed business model connects visitor spending, products and experiences, and local participation. Original project presentation, p. 12.
caption.zh: 拟定商业模式连接游客消费、产品与体验以及村民参与。原项目演示材料第12页。

text.en: I was responsible for market research and the design of the Jing Xiao Xi mascot, the Jingxi Heritage (京西·古韵) collection, and the Ancient Road Nostalgia (古道·乡愁) collection. I connected audience needs and purchase occasions with product concepts, then translated local landmarks, travel traditions, and seasonal scenery into character designs and souvenir collections. The wider product range and operating proposal were developed as a team.
text.zh: 我负责市场研究，以及京小喜吉祥物、“京西·古韵”和“古道·乡愁”系列文创设计。我将客群需求、购买场景与产品概念相联系，再把地方地标、行旅文化和四季景色转化为吉祥物与系列纪念品。更完整的产品体系和运营方案由团队共同完成。

heading.en: An established hiking route, an underused cultural resource
heading.zh: 已有徒步客流，文化资源仍待转化

text.en: Shuiyuzui Village sits on the Jingxi Ancient Road in Mentougou, western Beijing. The route and its surroundings include Niujiaoling Pass, hoofprints worn into the stone, and the former residence of the poet Ma Zhiyuan. About a 1.5-hour drive from central Beijing, its 5 km and 10 km loops are familiar to the city’s hiking community and attract repeat visitors. Yet many come mainly for exercise and scenery, spend little time exploring the road’s history, and make only a limited contribution to the local visitor economy.
text.zh: 水峪嘴村位于北京门头沟京西古道沿线，沿线及周边有牛角岭关城、马蹄窝和马致远故居等地标。这里距北京市区约1.5小时车程，5公里和10公里环线在北京徒步圈已有一定知名度，也吸引重复到访的游客。但许多人主要为了运动和看风景而来，对古道历史了解有限，对当地旅游消费的带动仍然不足。

text.en: Field visits, village interviews, and historical research shaped the proposal. Our early research identified fragmented promotion across attractions, a limited souvenir offering, and few interactive experiences. Demand was concentrated on weekends and holidays, with fewer visitors in winter. An ageing population and the departure of younger workers constrained local staffing, while the 2023 floods damaged parts of the tourism infrastructure. We therefore considered both what visitors might buy and what residents could realistically help make, explain, and sell.
text.zh: 实地考察、村民访谈和历史资料整理构成方案基础。前期调研发现，景点宣传较为分散，文创供给和互动体验不足；客流集中在周末、节假日，冬季较少。人口老龄化和年轻劳动力外流限制了当地用工，2023年洪灾又损坏了部分旅游设施。因此，我们同时考虑游客愿意买什么，以及村民能够参与哪些制作、讲解和销售工作。

text.en: A useful or memorable object gives visitors an accessible way into local culture. Someone who would not seek out a history lesson may still buy a postcard that records the walk, a well-designed magnet, or a practical cup. Each product can introduce a story at the point of purchase and continue to carry that story through everyday use or gifting. The aim was to connect cultural interpretation with an existing reason to visit.
text.zh: 一件实用或有纪念意义的物品，可以成为了解地方文化的入口。游客未必会专门听历史讲解，却可能购买一张记录行程的明信片、一件好看的冰箱贴或一只实用水杯。产品在购买时引出故事，也能通过日常使用和赠礼延续传播，把文化介绍与已有的游览动机联系起来。

text.en: Paper goods, fabric bags, and small keepsakes also offer a manageable starting point for limited production runs and feedback-based adjustments. Craft activities can give families a reason to stay longer, while online sales can support purchases after a visit. The village’s existing ice-cream production chain suggested another practical opportunity: landmark-shaped ice creams developed with a local manufacturer. These were proposed routes to revenue and participation, to be tested through production and sales.
text.zh: 纸品、布袋和小型纪念品适合从小批量生产起步，根据反馈调整。手作活动可增加家庭游客的停留时间，线上销售支持离店后购买。村里已有冰淇淋生产链，也为与当地厂家合作开发地标造型雪糕提供了条件。这些都是有待通过生产和销售验证的增收及参与路径。

heading.en: Market research: a different offer for each audience
heading.zh: 市场研究：针对不同客群设计方案

text.en: The market strategy grouped visitors by the purpose of their trip and the situation in which they might buy or participate. The original research distinguished organised groups from independent visitors; the product plan then connected each audience to a relevant activity, format, and price point.
text.zh: 市场策略依据出游目的和购买、参与场景区分游客。原始研究先区分团队客群与散客，再把不同人群与适合的活动、产品形式及价格层次对应。

heading.zh: 徒步爱好者与年轻散客

text.en: For visitors focused on walking, products need to be portable, reasonably priced, and connected to the route they have just completed. Postcards, route passports, badges, and magnets offer an easy purchase at a rest stop or the end of a walk. Landmark check-ins and stamps make the keepsake a record of the visit. Different landmarks and seasonal editions give returning hikers something new to discover.
text.zh: 徒步游客需要便携、价格适中、与亲自行走路线有关的产品。明信片、通关文牒、徽章和冰箱贴适合在休息点或行程结束时购买。地标打卡与盖章让纪念品成为游览记录，不同地标和季节主题则为重复到访提供新的选择。

text.en: Weekend families need activities they can enjoy together. The friendly mascot, hand-painted fans, and other DIY products can be paired with short stories about the ancient road. Children learn through images and making, while parents get a shared activity with a clear cultural connection. For school visits, landmark observation, interpretation, and craft sessions can form a structured educational programme.
text.zh: 周末家庭游客需要可以共同参与的活动。亲切的吉祥物、手绘团扇和DIY产品可配合简短的古道故事，让孩子通过图像与制作认识文化，让家长获得有内容的亲子体验。学校研学则可将地标观察、讲解和手作组织成完整活动。

text.en: University fieldwork, community engagement, team visits, and Party and Youth League activities create a different purchasing context: coordinated materials for a group. The Ancient Road · Original Aspiration collection proposes themed stationery and learning kits as activity supplies, prizes, or souvenirs. These can be packaged with visits, guided interpretation, and themed routes. The team’s experience organising campus activities offered an initial channel for outreach.
text.zh: 高校社会实践、团建和党团活动需要统一的团队物料。“古道·初心”系列提供主题文具与学习包，作为活动用品、奖品或纪念品，与参观、讲解和主题线路配套。团队已有的校园活动组织经验可作为初期对接渠道。

heading.zh: 文化兴趣游客与当地居民

text.en: For people interested in local history, and residents with a connection to the area, poetry, architecture, village scenes, and seasonal landscapes can support collecting, gifting, and a sense of belonging. Residents are also potential storytellers and sales partners. This makes their knowledge part of the visitor experience as well as a source for design.
text.zh: 对地方历史感兴趣的游客及当地居民，可通过诗词、建筑、村景和四季主题产品满足收藏、赠礼与乡土情感需求。居民也可以参与讲解和销售，让他们的地方知识同时成为游客体验和设计的资源。

heading.en: Design principle: one product, one story
heading.zh: 设计理念：一文创一故事

text.en: Every design starts with a specific local reference. Form, imagery, function, and story should reinforce one another so that a product feels connected to this place. Across the project, the team developed six families: the brand identity, Jing Xiao Xi, Ancient Road · Original Aspiration, Jingxi Heritage, Ancient Road Nostalgia, and Ancient Road Traveller. Four extensions covered DIY crafts, ice creams, packaging, and wayfinding. My design contribution focused on the following three collections.
text.zh: 每件设计都从具体的地方素材出发，让造型、图案、用途与故事相互对应。团队形成品牌标志、京小喜、古道·初心、京西·古韵、古道·乡愁和古道·行者六大系列，并延伸至DIY手作、文创冰淇淋、包装和路牌设计。我的设计工作集中在以下三个系列。

heading.en: Jing Xiao Xi — a character rooted in the road
heading.zh: 京小喜：从古道文化中生长的形象

text.en: The mascot draws on the lion imagery of Shitouling, or Lion’s Head Ridge. Peach blossoms refer to the flowers beside the ancient road; the bell recalls the pack animals that once transported goods; hoof-shaped boots echo the marks left by those journeys. I translated these references into a friendly character that could work across charms, stickers, red envelopes, and digital expressions. The shared character makes small products recognisable and gives family visitors an approachable guide to the road’s stories.
text.zh: 吉祥物取材于狮头岭的狮子意象：山桃花对应古道沿线的春日花景，铃铛呼应旧时驮运货物的骡队，蹄形靴对应行旅留下的马蹄印记。我将这些素材转化为亲切的角色，并延伸到挂件、贴纸、红包和表情包。统一形象让小件产品具有识别度，也为亲子游客提供易于亲近的故事讲述角色。

heading.en: Jingxi Heritage — carrying the landmarks home
heading.zh: 京西·古韵：把沿途地标带回家

text.en: This collection translates ancient-road architecture, landmarks, and poetry into postcards, bookmarks, and collectible stamp concepts. The illustrated buildings retain distinctive silhouettes and details so visitors can recognise places they have encountered. Cut-out postcard frames can be aligned with real scenery, inviting visitors to look more closely and create their own photographs. Together with route passports and check-in stamps, the collection connects walking, observing, recording, and taking a memory home.
text.zh: 这一系列将古道建筑、地标与诗词转化为明信片、书签和邮票设计。地标插画保留具有辨识度的轮廓与细节，让游客对应沿途看到的地点。镂空明信片可与实景结合，鼓励观察和拍照；配合通关文牒与打卡印章，把行走、观看、记录和纪念连接起来。

text.en: The stamp concepts extend the same idea through village scenes, historic buildings, and travel imagery. A small format becomes a way to collect multiple impressions of the route, rather than compress its identity into a single landmark.
text.zh: 邮票设计通过村庄景色、历史建筑和行旅意象延伸这一思路，让小幅面承载对古道的多种印象。

heading.en: Ancient Road Nostalgia — four seasons, one collection
heading.zh: 古道·乡愁：四季组成一个系列

text.en: Spring blossoms, summer greenery, autumn colour, and winter snow define four colour palettes and compositions. The fan-shaped magnets can be bought individually or assembled into a complete circle. This makes the seasons both a visual system and a product structure: each piece stands on its own, while the set tells a fuller story of the landscape. It also creates a connection between repeated visits, seasonal change, and collecting.
text.zh: 春花、夏叶、秋色和冬雪形成四组配色与构图。扇形冰箱贴可以单独购买，也能组合成完整圆形。四季同时成为视觉体系和产品结构：每件独立成立，组合后呈现更完整的地方景观，并将重复游览、季节变化与收藏联系起来。

heading.zh: 让方案能够在当地运行

text.en: The wider team proposal placed different offers at the entrance, rest stops along the route, and the village’s commercial street. Drinks, ice creams, and portable keepsakes suit a short stop; the village shop can support a fuller product display, storytelling, and craft activities. The Ancient Road Traveller collection extends travel imagery into cups, umbrellas, fans, and bags, while the Original Aspiration collection serves organised learning and group visits.
text.zh: 团队整体方案在入口、沿途补给点和村内商业街配置不同内容。途中适合饮品、雪糕及便携纪念品，村内门店适合完整产品展示、故事讲解和手作活动。“古道·行者”将行旅意象融入杯子、雨伞、团扇和布袋，“古道·初心”则服务集体学习与团队参访。

text.en: The proposed digital layer brings together route information, stories, product browsing, and purchases through a WeChat mini-program. Interface designs were completed, with Xiaohongshu and WeChat channels included in the promotion plan. Campus and institutional partnerships, regional tourism collaboration, and social content were intended to lead visitors to relevant routes, products, and experiences.
text.zh: 拟定的数字服务通过微信小程序整合路线、故事、产品展示和购买，已完成界面设计；推广方案包含小红书、微信公众号、校园及机构合作和区域文旅联动，将游客引向适配的线路、产品与体验。

text.en: Pricing was planned across several spending levels: RMB 5 for stickers, RMB 10 for badges, RMB 30 for canvas bags, and RMB 150–180 for lifestyle or learning kits. These are proposed prices from the project plan, subject to production costs and trial sales. Small-batch testing would help identify which products visitors actually value before expanding the range or committing to larger inventories.
text.zh: 拟定价格覆盖不同消费层次：贴纸5元、徽章10元、帆布袋30元，生活包和学习包150—180元。这些是策划书中的计划价格，需根据生产成本与试销调整。小批量测试可帮助确认游客真正愿意购买的产品，再扩大品类和库存。

text.en: The team completed 68 product design drafts, a product catalogue, supporting story materials, and mini-program interface designs. The project also included hand-painting guidance for villagers and preparation of sales explanations. These outputs form a basis for prototyping and testing; they do not establish realised sales or a measured increase in village income. The next step is to validate willingness to buy, production quality, and margins, then expand the products that work. The goal is practical: give visitors more reasons to engage and spend locally, while making the stories of the Jingxi Ancient Road easier to understand and remember.
text.zh: 团队完成68件文创设计稿、产品画册、故事材料和小程序界面，并开展村民手绘指导与销售讲解准备。这些产出为打样和测试提供基础，尚不能代表实际销售或已测得的增收。后续需要验证购买意愿、生产质量和利润，再扩展有效产品，让游客有更多理由了解古道、在当地消费，并带走对地方文化的记忆。

title.en: A Place Called Silence: Short-Video Campaign

content.en: A short-video campaign for A Place Called Silence, built around genre insights, the film’s strengths, and audience emotions, with a phased content and creator strategy.
content.zh: 围绕类型洞察、影片卖点与观众情绪制定的《默杀》短视频营销方案，结合分阶段内容策略与达人传播。

caption.zh: 同类影片分析：基础吸引力与传播潜力

explanation.en: The proposal concludes that curiosity and suspense establish audience interest, while reversals and socially relevant emotions create additional reach. This distinction separates the core genre promise from the reasons a viewer might share or discuss the film.
explanation.zh: 方案区分类型基础吸引力与扩散潜力：悬疑和猎奇建立兴趣，反转与社会情绪推动分享和讨论。

caption.zh: 影片优势、风险与信息提炼

explanation.en: The assessment highlights strong suspense, visual impact, performances, and discussion topics. It also identifies genre fatigue and an overly complex story as risks, leading to a need for a simpler, more distinctive campaign message.
explanation.zh: 分析突出悬疑、视觉冲击、表演及讨论议题，同时识别类型疲劳与故事要素过多的风险，提出简化信息、突出差异点的方向。

explanation.en: Four pillars organise the pre-release content: suspense, striking visual moments, social themes, and morally ambiguous characters. Each offers a different hook while reinforcing the film’s crime-thriller positioning.
explanation.zh: 映前内容围绕悬疑、视觉冲击、社会议题及人物秘密展开，以不同钩子共同强化犯罪悬疑定位。

explanation.en: The plan moves from an unconventional suspense premise to character secrets, then to post-release reversals and word of mouth. Film content and audience emotions are paired at each stage to make the rollout more coherent.
explanation.zh: 策略依次推进反套路悬疑、人物秘密和映后反转口碑；每一阶段将影片内容与对应观众情绪配对，形成连贯排期。

caption.zh: 达人互动：名场面模仿挑战

explanation.en: A proposed challenge uses a recognisable performance moment and the film’s music as a repeatable creator format. The aim is to make campaign participation accessible to wider audiences after the film’s release.
explanation.zh: 通过具有识别度的表演片段与电影音乐设计可复制的达人形式，降低映后参与门槛，推动更广泛的观众互动。

caption.en: Audience activation: silence or speaking up
caption.zh: 观众互动：沉默还是发声

explanation.en: The proposed screening activation asks viewers how they would respond as witnesses to bullying. It connects the film’s central theme to a participatory question, giving creators and viewers a discussion format beyond plot summaries.
explanation.zh: 观影现场互动邀请观众思考面对霸凌时的选择，将影片核心议题转化为可参与、可讨论的形式，拓展剧情介绍之外的传播内容。

text.en: Prepared during my Maoyan Entertainment marketing internship, this 53-page proposal focuses on short-video promotion for A Place Called Silence. It connects comparable-film analysis, the film’s strengths and risks, release-stage messaging, content ideas, and creator-led events into a campaign plan.
text.zh: 这份53页方案形成于猫眼娱乐市场营销实习期间，围绕《默杀》开展短视频推广策划，将同类影片分析、影片优势与风险、上映阶段信息、内容选题及达人活动串联为完整营销方案。

text.en: I began with comparable-film analysis to understand what draws audiences to crime thrillers and what makes them talk about a film afterwards. Suspense and curiosity established the genre’s core appeal; reversals, emotional payoff, and socially relevant themes offered reasons to share and discuss it. This distinction gave the proposal a foundation for both attention and wider conversation.
text.zh: 我先通过同类影片分析，理解犯罪悬疑片如何吸引观众，以及观众为什么会在观影后讨论和分享。悬疑与猎奇构成类型基础吸引力；反转、情绪释放和社会议题则提供扩散的理由。这一区分为方案的注意力获取与话题传播建立了基础。

text.en: Applying those findings to A Place Called Silence, I assessed its suspense, visual impact, performances, and social themes against the risks of genre fatigue and a complex multi-character story. The campaign needed a clear hook. The contrast between bullying, the victims’ silence, and the bullies’ unexplained deaths led to a central question: who is responsible, and what is each character hiding?
text.zh: 将这些结论用于《默杀》后，我评估影片的悬疑、视觉冲击、表演与社会议题，也考虑类型疲劳和多人物故事过于复杂的风险。传播需要一个清晰钩子：霸凌、受害者的沉默与霸凌者离奇死亡形成反差，最终聚焦于“谁是凶手，每个人又隐瞒了什么？”这一核心问题。

text.en: From that positioning, I organised pre-release messaging around four pillars: suspense, striking visual moments, social themes, and morally ambiguous characters. They provided different entry points for short videos while keeping the campaign’s crime-thriller promise consistent.
text.zh: 在这一定位之上，我将映前信息组织为四个支柱：悬疑、视觉冲击、社会议题与多面人物。它们为短视频提供不同入口，同时保持犯罪悬疑的统一传播定位。

text.en: The rollout then became a three-stage sequence. First, establish the unconventional suspense premise and the severity of bullying. Next, reveal conflicting identities and character secrets, pairing suspense with emotional topics. After release, shift towards reversals, performance highlights, and detail analysis, giving viewers reasons to discuss the story and revisit it.
text.zh: 排期由此形成三个阶段：首先建立反套路悬疑设定与霸凌冲突；随后逐步呈现人物的多面身份与秘密，以悬疑结合情绪话题；上映后转向反转、表演亮点和细节解读，延长讨论并提供重复观看的理由。

text.en: To make that sequence usable, the content plan paired film scenes with behind-the-scenes footage, cast interviews, proposed hashtags, and creator formats. Suspense and social themes carried the main story, while cast reactions and contrasting performances offered lighter entry points. A proposed scene-recreation challenge used a recognisable performance moment and the film’s music as a repeatable format for creator participation.
text.zh: 为了让阶段策略落到具体内容，方案将正片片段、拍摄花絮、主创采访、预设话题与达人形式配对。悬疑和社会议题承载主线，演员反应与表演反差提供更轻量的入口。名场面模仿挑战则利用具有识别度的表演片段与电影音乐，形成可复制的达人参与形式。

text.en: The final activation extended the film’s themes into an audience question: as a witness to bullying, would you remain silent or speak up? A proposed screening event would invite viewers and creators to respond, creating a discussion format beyond plot summaries. It connected the emotional themes identified in the research with a concrete participation idea.
text.zh: 最后，互动设计将影片议题转化为观众可以回答的问题：面对霸凌，作为旁观者会选择沉默还是发声？拟议的观影活动邀请观众和达人表达选择，在剧情介绍之外建立讨论形式，把前期研究中的社会情绪转化为具体参与方式。

text.en: The completed 53-page proposal connected market evidence, a focused film position, release-stage priorities, and practical content and creator ideas. I also took an active role in the subsequent rollout, helping oversee the planning, filming, and editing of nearly 300 short videos promoting the film on Douyin, Rednote, and WeChat Channels.
text.zh: 最终的53页方案串联市场依据、清晰的影片定位、上映阶段重点与具体内容及达人创意。我也深度参与后续项目实施，协助监制近300条短视频的策划、拍摄和剪辑，在抖音、小红书和微信视频号推广电影。

content.en: Launching Wuerli Hotel’s social media presence through short videos of everyday life, food, gatherings, and the changing weather in Yunnan.
content.zh: 从零搭建焐尔里民宿的社交媒体账号，以云南的日常生活、美食、聚会与天气为素材，开展短视频内容策划和运营。

galleryIntro.zh: 在焐尔里民宿负责新媒体运营期间，我全权负责宣传推广与账号冷启动，统筹视频策划、拍摄、剪辑、后期制作及日常账号运营。这四支短片记录炭火上的烤奶、篝火旁的相聚，以及雨中和雨后的片刻。
galleryIntro.en: At Wuerli Hotel, I led promotion and launched its social accounts from scratch, covering video planning, filming, editing, post-production and daily operations. These four films capture roasted milk over embers, an evening together by the fire, and moments during and after the rain.

content.en: Social media content and community operations supporting user growth at an early-stage startup.
content.zh: 在初创公司开展社交媒体内容与社群运营，支持用户增长。

text.en: As a User Growth Intern at Gagabang, I worked on Rednote content operations and community management. The role connected social media activity with the startup’s user-growth work.
text.zh: 在 Gagabang 担任用户增长实习生期间，我参与小红书内容运营与社群管理，将社交媒体工作与公司的用户增长连接起来。

title.zh: 人像摄影：个人创业项目

content.en: An independent portrait-photography venture offering paid sessions. I design each shoot’s theme around the sitter’s personality and presence, then develop the styling, setting and visual mood to suit her.
content.zh: 我的个人摄影业务以收费人像约拍为主。我会根据每位拍摄对象的气质设计主题，再围绕她的特点安排造型、场景和画面的氛围。

content.en: Photographs and short films from my solo travels across China, collected by region.
content.zh: 独自旅行时拍下的风景、街头与日常，以及沿途制作的短片，按地区整理。

description.zh: 北国的冬天，雪落在山林与屋檐上。冷色的远景与暖色的街巷交替，记录寒冷里仍鲜活的日常。
description.en: Winter in the northeast: snow settles over mountains, forests and rooftops. Cool landscapes give way to warm streets, revealing everyday life in the cold.

description.zh: 从黄土高原到泰山，再到河南的中原腹地，这条旅途穿过中华文化的重要发源地。土地的纹理、山势与古老建筑，留下厚重而悠长的时间感。
description.en: From the Loess Plateau and Mount Tai to the heartland of Henan, this journey passes through a cradle of Chinese culture. Textured earth, mountain silhouettes and old architecture carry a deep sense of time.

description.zh: 北京是我的家乡。古都的红墙、胡同与人间日常，构成我熟悉的华北记忆；向东走，海岸又为这片土地打开另一种辽阔。
description.en: Beijing is my hometown. Red walls, hutongs and everyday scenes form my memories of North China; farther east, the coast opens onto a different kind of vastness.

description.zh: 广西是妈妈的老家，也是一份亲近的乡土记忆。桂林的山水在雾气与光线中展开，山的轮廓、水的倒影，都是温柔的线条。
description.en: Guangxi is my mother’s home, a landscape that feels close to my own roots. In Guilin, mist and light soften the mountains and their reflections into gentle lines.

description.zh: 水巷、桥影与临水的屋舍，把江南的节奏放慢。我用镜头收集水乡的细部，让流动的水与安静的生活彼此映照。
description.en: Waterways, bridges and houses along the banks slow the rhythm of Jiangnan. My photographs linger on small details, where moving water meets quiet daily life.

description.zh: 从湖南、广东到香港，我喜欢这些地方鲜活的人间烟火。街巷、江边与城市里的寻常片段，让我停下来，看南方生活的不同节奏。
description.en: From Hunan and Guangdong to Hong Kong, I am drawn to the warmth of everyday life. Streets, riverbanks and ordinary urban moments reveal the different rhythms of southern China.

description.zh: 茫茫沙漠、伸向天际的公路与青海湖，是西北留给我的辽阔记忆。画面里的留白与长长的线条，让独行也有了自由的尺度。
description.en: Desert, roads reaching the horizon and Qinghai Lake stay with me as memories of the northwest. Open space and long lines give travelling alone a sense of freedom.

description.zh: 西南是我最喜欢的地方。云南的春意、蜀地的青山与竹海，让旅途始终带着生机；我喜欢在层层绿色中寻找光，也寻找慢下来的理由。
description.en: The southwest is my favourite place: the springlike feeling of Yunnan, and Sichuan’s green mountains and bamboo. I look for light among the layers of green, and reasons to slow down.

description.zh: 走上青藏高原，山、湖与天空把视野推得更远。沿途的祈愿与信仰，为壮阔的风景添上安静而具体的人间温度。
description.en: On the Tibetan Plateau, mountains, lakes and sky stretch the view farther. Moments of prayer and devotion bring a quiet human warmth to the expansive landscape.

content.zh: 2023年10月17日，北师大北国剧社的学生版《雷雨》在北京人艺曹禺剧场上演。在人艺老师的指导下，我们用三个多月的准备、近200小时的排练，将这部经典搬上舞台。
content.en: On 17 October 2023, Beiguo Drama Society at Beijing Normal University brought its student production of Thunderstorm to Beijing People’s Art Theatre’s Cao Yu Theatre. With guidance from the theatre’s professionals, we prepared for more than three months and rehearsed for nearly 200 hours.

text.zh: 我作为北国剧社一方的项目负责人，从选题初期到最终演出全程参与。忙碌之余，我还为活动制作了三集幕后纪录片，记录剧组入场、排练和演出的过程。
text.en: As the project lead representing Beiguo Drama Society, I was involved from the initial choice of play through to the final performance. In my spare time, I also made a three-part behind-the-scenes documentary, following the team’s arrival at the theatre, rehearsals and performance.
